1: A rough wooden landing on a wide river at dawn in thick mist: a French woman of about fifty with an oval face, calm dark eyes, strong dark brows and dark hair under a white linen coif, in a plain dark wool gown, white collar and a dark shawl, stands at the edge in a dark cloak with her hand raised to her brow watching a seventeenth-century sailing ship approach; far behind her on the water a few women in dark cloaks seen only from behind; her face clearly visible in three-quarter view. Hard low light, dark forest. No children.
3: A plain seventeenth-century room with a table and one candle: a French woman of about fifty with an oval face, calm dark eyes, strong dark brows and dark hair under a white linen coif, in a plain dark wool gown, white collar and a dark shawl, sits and listens kindly to a woman in her twenties in a plain dark gown who sits beside her, both faces clearly visible in three-quarter view, the older woman's hand resting on the younger one's, hard side light, deep shadows. No other people. No children.
5: The open doorway of a plain wooden house in winter, a street of snow and log houses outside: a French woman of about fifty with an oval face, calm dark eyes, strong dark brows and dark hair under a white linen coif, in a plain dark wool gown, white collar and a dark shawl, stands in the doorway facing the street with her face clearly visible in three-quarter view, with two women in simple dark gowns seated behind her at a table sewing, seen from the side; hard light from the doorway, no walls or gates, free and open. No children.
7: A candlelit seventeenth-century room with a plain table: a French woman of about fifty with an oval face, calm dark eyes, strong dark brows and dark hair under a white linen coif, in a plain dark wool gown, white collar and a dark shawl, holds a sealed document in both hands and reads it, her face clearly visible in three-quarter view, moved and grateful, a single candle, hard side light, deep shadows, a small crucifix on the wall. No other people. No children.
8: A snowy path leading toward a small fort-town of log houses and a palisade on a river island, late afternoon, mist: a French woman of about fifty with an oval face, calm dark eyes, strong dark brows and dark hair under a white linen coif, in a plain dark wool gown, white collar and a dark shawl, walks along it with a woman companion in a dark cloak, both seen from the side and slightly behind, small in the frame, her face faintly visible in profile; long shadows, hard low light. No children.
